answer: Scented Slow-Release Credentials. Each identity is seeded with a unique nectar trace that releases only after 90 days of continuous signing; early termination voids it. Clones must run full parallel duration before earning a single sonnet-weight vote, and each cohort shares a finite meadow allowance of trace material, so N clones split one identity's yield. Attacker cost: N×90 days of infrastructure plus diluted rewards.
